EXACT ALL-n COLLECTIVE LIE GIBBS CLASSICAL ARCHIVE
8 October 2026. /root/sol_classicality. No workers spawned.
Status: INTERNALLY-PROVED-CANDIDATE; the distinct hostile/resource audit
of Sections3--7 passed with scope clarifications recorded in Section8.
Root independently derived the all-group entropy mechanism.
Sol_hyperbolic_audit supplied the covariance/commutation step giving
the sharper all-group trace rate; it passed a separate Sol check below.
External validation and historical equivalence/priority UNKNOWN.
No growing-dimension LAN theorem or asymptotic Schur approximation is used.

1. GENERAL FIXED-GROUP RESULT: ONE UNKNOWN LINEAR PARAMETER, ALL n
Fix a compact connected simple G, physics weight metric long-root squared1,
rank r, p=|R^+|, and an irreducible nontrivial known carrier H_Lambda,
Lambda=sum_i n_i omega_i, N=sum_i n_i>=1. Let T_theta denote its
Hermitian represented Lie operator for a vector theta in the invariant
Lie metric. Supply n identical copies of ONE unknown member

  rho_(Lambda,theta)=exp(T_theta/N)/Z_(Lambda,theta),
  ||theta||<=h1.                                         (1)

The vector theta, including its direction and length, is UNKNOWN to
both encoder and decoder. The same channel works for the entire
bounded vector ball, hence any supplied thermal conjugation orbit and
any unknown temperature in that bound. The group, carrier, n and
scale N are known/public model structure. No broadcaster or calibration
is assumed. Different independent parameters on the n copies are outside
scope.

There is a parameter-independent EB archive channel C_(Lambda,n) with

  D(rho_(Lambda,theta)^tensor n || C_(Lambda,n)(rho^tensor n))
       <=B_G h1/N,
  (1/2)||rho^tensor n-C_(Lambda,n)(rho^tensor n)||_1
       <=1-exp(-B_G h1/N)<=B_G h1/N,
  B_G=sum_(alpha in R^+)||alpha||,                        (2)

for EVERY n>=1. This error is independent of n, carrier dimension,
weight-face ratios and multiplicities. It may be capped by1.
This is ordinary family trace reconstruction, with no inaccessible
quantum reference and no diamond-norm or purification recovery claim.

The retained classical label count has the explicit polynomial bound

  B_arch <=C_G(1+nN)^(r+4p),
  C_G=2(1+a_G)^r(1+b_G)^(4p),
  a_G=2w_G/min_(simple alpha)||alpha||,
  b_G=w_G max_(alpha in R^+) ||alpha^vee||/(rho,alpha^vee),
  w_G=max_i||omega_i||.
